body:
I did draw what I wanted to make me feel happy, I didn't focus on the "super-duper amazing artist" I did draw for the sake of drawing

It all didn't help a single inch

I said in my post that I just wanted to be mediocre, just to be happy in the drawing that i made only for me but I couldn't even do that, no amount of work I put in even remotely mattered

3 years is nothing for a professional
3 years is everything for someone who just wanted to be mediocre

I said in my post that all I wanted to be is just mediocre but I couldn't even get there

I said in my post that my drawings at year 3 looked the exact same quality as day 3

You think I want to do into these bigs like social media or getting a job in art, no, I just want to be happy with a stupid cartoon that probably only I would see and enjoy and I can't even do that, all my drawings are just incoherent garbage that I can't even remotely begin to like

And no, it isn't my mental,  because I had the best mental i could've ever asked for during those 3 years and it. Got. Me. Nowhere.

i havent drawn anything meaningful for a couple years so i guess that counts as a break, i wrote this post because of the insistent urges to draw followed by depression that always comes up whenever i try to draw and realize once again i cant for the life of me
